Hi list,



I was wondering if someone would mind giving me a pointer on how to fetch
the Census 2010 Total Population count as well as the 2013 estimate.



pawleys <- geo.make(state="SC", county="Georgetown", place="Pawleys")



pawleys_pop <- acs.fetch(endyear=2013, span=5, geography=pawleys,
table.number="B01003")



maybe a dataset=?



thanks,

Tyler

messages.body_plain:
Unfortunately, although the API provides access to the decennial data,
the acs.R package is not currently configured to access it (the format
for the api calls is a bit different, and the data fetched doesn't
include standard errors).  That said, I think I can pretty easily
write up a modified version of acs.fetch() to provide this
functionality, at least is a clunky way  -- give me a day or so to try
it out.

messages.subject: [acs-r] 2013 5-year available?
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

It seems that the 2013 5-yr ACS is now available on the Census API
<http://www.census.gov/data/developers/updates/acs-5-yr-summary-available-2009-2013.html>.
However, the latest year I can load with this package is 2012
<http://eglenn.scripts.mit.edu/citystate/2014/01/acs-r-version-1-2-now-with-2012-data/>
.

I am running the latest version of this package (1.2). Are there plans to
include access to the 2013 data? Or is there a method to do this currently
that I have missed?

Thank you for maintaining this great package!

Sincerely,

Matt Schumwinger
biglakedata.com

messages.subject: [acs-r] 2013 5-year available?
messages.body_plain:
Thanks for your email, and for using the acs.R package.

At present, the package will fetch the 2013 5-year ACS data, with two
important caveats: 

(1) you must specify the table number or variable number directly --
you can't use keywords, since the current version of the package lacks
the correct lookup tables for 2013; and

(2) the acs.fetch function will give you some warnings about how "As
of the date of this version of the acs package Census API did not
provides data for selected endyear" -- but you can safely ignore that.

See below for a basic example:

--Ezra


> acs.fetch(geography=geo.make(state=25, county="*"), table.number="B01003", endyear=2013)

messages.subject: [acs-r] Visualize ACS ZCTA data with choroplethrZip
messages.subject_clean: [acs-r] Visualize ACS ZCTA data with choroplethrZip
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to let you know that I just wrote a package which can visualize
the ZCTA (Zip Code Tabulated Area) data from the acs package with my new
package choroplethrZip <https://github.com/arilamstein/choroplethrZip>.

The acs visualization capability are described in this vignette
<http://rpubs.com/arilamstein/choroplethrZip-b>.

Ari
